cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team. The role is responsible for performing high complexity Clinical Diagnostic patient testing and clinical trial testing covered under CLIA.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.
Solid knowledge and application of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a timely manner, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient. Ability to take direction well, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational and communication skills, highly computer literate.

cond_0010.responsibilities:
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.

Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.

Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.

Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.

Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.

Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational, and communication skills, highly computer literate.
Primarily laboratory environment with exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.

cond_0050.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team at [Company name masked], a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited, [Location masked] licensed clinical diagnostic testing facility providing esoteric testing services to top reference laboratories and supporting clinical trial testing. The Medical Technologist is responsible for performing high complexity Clinical Diagnostic patient testing and clinical trial testing covered under CLIA. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with high complexity clinical diagnostic testing and laboratory procedures.
cond_0050.responsibilities:
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0050.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.
Solid knowledge and application of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Ability to work where multiple concurrent projects must be completed in a timely manner remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient with a high level of professionalism. Ability to take direction well, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational, and communication skills, highly computer literate.
Working Environment:
Primarily laboratory environment
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets
Physical Demands:
Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
Frequent mobility needed
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task
Regular and consistent attendance

cond_0058.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team at [Company name masked]. [Company name masked] Diagnostics is a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited, [Location masked] licensed clinical diagnostic testing facility providing esoteric testing services to top reference laboratories and supporting clinical trial testing. The Medical Technologist is responsible for performing high complexity Clinical Diagnostic patient testing and clinical trial testing covered under CLIA. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical diagnostic workflows and regulatory requirements.
cond_0058.responsibilities:
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0058.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.
Solid knowledge and application of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.
Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational and communication skills, highly computer literate.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a timely manner, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient with a high level of professionalism. Ability to take direction well, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Working Environment
Primarily laboratory environment
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets
Physical Demands
Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
Frequent mobility needed
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task
Regular and consistent attendance

cond_0274.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team at [Company name masked]. [Company name masked] Diagnostics is a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited, [Location masked] licensed clinical diagnostic testing facility providing esoteric testing services to top reference laboratories and supporting clinical trial testing. The Medical Technologist is responsible for performing high complexity Clinical Diagnostic patient testing and clinical trial testing covered under CLIA. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of clinical diagnostic workflows and regulatory requirements.
cond_0274.responsibilities:
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0274.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.
Solid knowledge and application of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.
Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational and communication skills, highly computer literate.
Preferred Requirements
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a timely manner, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient with a high level of professionalism. Ability to take direction well, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Working Environment
Primarily laboratory environment
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets
Physical Demands
Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
Frequent mobility needed
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task
Regular and consistent attendance
cond_0274.values: We value achievement and a strong commitment to quality in what we deliver. We aim to set high standards and meet them consistently.

cond_0300.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team.
cond_0300.responsibilities:
Essential Responsibilities
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0300.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science, or equivalent practical experience.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent, or willingness to obtain.
Around five (5) years of experience running high complexity assays, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a timely manner, staying flexible and organized, with a professional approach. Ability to take direction, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Hands-on laboratory skills including low volume pipetting in 96-well plates and familiarity with standard laboratory instrumentation.
Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Attention to detail and good organizational and communication skills; comfort with computer systems and software.
Working Environment
Primarily laboratory environment
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets

Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
Frequent mobility needed
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task
Regular and consistent attendance

cond_0444.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team.
cond_0444.responsibilities:
Essential Responsibilities
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0444.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science, or equivalent practical experience.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent, or willingness to obtain.
Around five (5) years of experience running high complexity assays, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a timely manner, staying flexible and organized, with a professional approach. Ability to take direction, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Hands-on laboratory skills including low volume pipetting in 96-well plates and familiarity with standard laboratory instrumentation.
Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Attention to detail and good organizational and communication skills; comfort with computer systems and software.
Working Environment
Primarily laboratory environment
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets
Physical Demands
Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
Frequent mobility needed
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task
Regular and consistent attendance

cond_0558.intro:
We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team.
As part of a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited, [Location masked] licensed clinical diagnostic testing facility, you will work alongside colleagues to provide esoteric testing services to top reference laboratories and support clinical trial testing.
cond_0558.responsibilities:
Coordinate with the team to perform HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyze, review, approve, and report test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintain paper and electronic records of test results.
Follow quality assurance procedures and participate in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identify problems that may adversely affect test performance, work with Laboratory Management to troubleshoot test systems and take appropriate action. Keep Customer Service informed of any issues that may cause late results.
Perform and document routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration, and scheduled and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participate in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Support audits and inspections, and assist in responding to observations, if applicable.
Keep current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Coordinate the technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and support other technologists working on those assays. Help train other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Participate in project-based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
cond_0558.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in medical technology or related life science.
National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.
Solid knowledge and application of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a timely manner, remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient with a high level of professionalism. Ability to take direction well, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational and communication skills, highly computer literate.
Working Environment:
Primarily laboratory environment
Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets
Physical Demands:
Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
Frequent mobility needed
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task
Regular and consistent attendance

National certification as a Medical Technologist MT (ASCP) / MT (AAB) or Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS) through the American Society for Clinical Pathology (ASCP) or equivalent.
Not less than five (5) years' experience of running high complexity assays.
Solid knowledge and application of CLIA, CAP, and CLEP regulations, standards, and guidelines.
Ability to work where multiple concurrent projects must be completed in a timely manner remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient with a high level of professionalism. Ability to take direction well, multi-task, and exercise sound independent judgment within areas of responsibility.
Strong hands-on laboratory skills: low volume pipetting in 96-well plates, confident and competent user of state-of-the-art laboratory instrumentation.
Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
Acute attention to detail and excellent organizational, and communication skills, highly computer literate.
Primarily laboratory environment with exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste. Personal protective equipment is required and provided, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves.
Routine use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets.
Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to eight (8) hours per day.
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment.
Frequent mobility needed.
Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects, including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer, with a maximum lift of 20 pounds.

Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
Requires multiple periods of intense concentration.
Perform a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence; ability to perform under stress; ability to multi-task.
Regular and consistent attendance.

cond_0644.intro: We are looking for a Medical Technologist to join our team at [Company name masked], a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited, [Location masked] licensed clinical diagnostic testing facility providing esoteric testing services to top reference laboratories and supporting clinical trial testing. The Medical Technologist is responsible for performing high complexity Clinical Diagnostic patient testing and clinical trial testing covered under CLIA. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with high complexity clinical diagnostic testing and laboratory procedures.
cond_0644.responsibilities:
Performing HIPAA-compliant high complexity testing according to approved procedures and within established turnaround times.
Analyzing, reviewing, approving, and reporting test and quality control results according to established acceptance criteria and approved procedures. Maintaining paper and electronic records of test results.
Complying with quality assurance procedures, participating in proficiency testing and competency evaluation throughout the year.
Identifying problems which may adversely affect test performance, troubleshooting test systems and taking appropriate action when appropriate or as directed by Laboratory Management. Including proactively informing Customer Service of any issues which may cause late results.
Performing and documenting routine equipment use, maintenance, calibration as well as routine, scheduled, and unscheduled preventive maintenance.
Participating in method development and equipment qualification activities as directed by Laboratory Management.
Supporting audits, inspections, and assisting in responding to observations, if applicable.
Maintaining current knowledge of relevant regulations, standards, guidelines, and MT certification through continuing education.
Overseeing technical and logistical aspects of assigned assays and the work of other technologists on those assays. Training other technologists on tests and laboratory procedures.
Actively participating in project based and continuous improvement work and other duties as needed.
